text.content:
Those who manipulate the raw energy within creatures' souls, influencing emotions and vital force.

SKILLS

HEALING POWER · SL max 2

When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may have each of those allies recover an amount of Hit Points equal to (3 + (SL, multiplied by the number of Bonds you have)).

This healing is separate from any healing caused by the effects of the spell.

SPIRITUAL MAGIC · SL max 10

Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Spiritist spell (see the next two pages). Offensive (O) Spiritist spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

SUPPORT MAGIC

When you cast a spell that targets one or more allies, if you have an arcane weapon equipped, you may choose one of those allies you have a Bond towards. If you do, that ally gains a bonus to the next Check they perform during the current scene; this bonus is equal to the strength of your Bond towards them.

VISMAGUS

When you cast a spell, if you do not have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to spend an amount of Hit Points equal to (10 + the spell's total MP cost) instead. If a spell cast this way would cause you to recover Hit Points, you instead recover no Hit Points (the spell functions normally on any other target).

BODY OF AETHER · SL max 4

When you perform a Ritual, the Mind Point cost is reduced by (SL × 4).

Additionally, when you perform a Ritual and you don't have enough Mind Points to pay for its total cost, you may choose to cover any amount of the cost with Hit Points instead. You may use this Skill even if doing so would reduce you to 0 Hit Points, but you must Sacrifice yourself in the process.

SURGE OF EMOTION · SL max 3

When you invoke one of your Bonds, choose one of the emotions tied to it and follow the corresponding effect. This is not optional.

  • Admiration: The players and the Game Master each generate (SL) opportunities that may be spent at any time before the end of the scene.
  • Inferiority: Each of (SL) creatures you can see triggers a fumble the next time this scene that they perform a Check and both dice show the same number (even if that Check would have been a critical success).
  • Loyalty: Choose a creature you can see. Until the end of the scene, any Check either of you makes automatically becomes a Group Check supported by the other.
  • Mistrust: (SL) creatures you can see have their senses momentarily suppressed. During a conflict, they cannot spend Mind Points until the end of their next turn.
  • Affection: Choose (SL) creatures you can see other than yourself. They use your Attributes instead of their own on the next Check they perform this scene.
  • Hatred: (SL) creatures you can see become enraged.

SPELLS

PROPHYLACTIC AEGIS · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense score as being equal to 12 (they may still use their normal Magic Defense score if it is higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 14 if you are level 40 or higher.

TONIC EXCITATION · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

You allow a creature to focus their vital energy into accomplishing what they previously could not. Choose one Attribute: Dexterity, Insight, Might, or Willpower. Until this spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of d12).

REFRACTORY PALISADE · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You project your soul outside your body and weave it into a barrier to protect the targets from attacks. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Defense score as being equal to 12 (they may still use their normal Defense score if it is higher than 12). This value increases to 13 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 14 if you are level 40 or higher.

DEPURATIVE REGIMEN · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You strengthen and purify the soul energy coursing through your companions. Each target recovers from all status effects.

CHOLERIC PROVOCATION [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You cause a creature to lose any semblance of temper and act brazenly. The target suffers enraged and cannot perform the Guard or Spell actions until the end of their next turn.

DELUSIVE IMPRESSION [Z] · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You alter the senses of your enemies, causing them to experience bizarre or frightening hallucinations. Choose dazed or shaken: each target hit by this spell suffers the chosen status effect.

GENERAL RESTORATION · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You invigorate your companions, soothing their pain and easing their fatigue. Each target recovers 40 Hit Points. This amount increases to 50 Hit Points if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 Hit Points if you are level 40 or higher.

LUMINOUS CAUTERY [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You focus your inner energy into a barrage of blinding soul rays. You deal (HR + 15) light damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers dazed.

ALDWORTH'S COMPRESS · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

You strengthen the heart of a creature against suffering and despair. Until this spell ends, if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, they are instead left standing with exactly 1 Hit Point. Once that happens, this spell ends.

ACQUIRED TOLERANCE · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You protect the targets from attacks that would corrupt their body and spirit. Choose dazed, enraged, poisoned, shaken, slow, or weak. Until this spell ends, each target is immune to the chosen status effect.

ANODYNE MANTLE · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You weave energy to safeguard the targets. Choose a damage type: dark, light, or poison. Until this spell ends, each target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type.

ACTINIC PLATING · 5 MP · One equipped weapon · Scene

You imbue a weapon with the cleansing energy of your spirit. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes light. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

ATTENUATIVE DRAUGHT [Z] · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You smother the soul energy coursing through the bodies of your foes, hindering their movements. Choose slow or weak: each target hit by this spell suffers the chosen status effect.

ANTIPHONAL RELIEF · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Scene

You call upon the spirits to join you in song and reinvigorate your allies' spirits. Until this spell ends, each target that is about to pay a Mind Point cost may halve that cost. Then, the effects of this spell ends for that target. This spell cannot be cast on a creature benefiting from the Massage Camp Activity (see Natural Fantasy Atlas, page 133), and its benefit cannot be applied to a Ritual's cost in Mind Points. This spell is treated as a verse for the purposes of Chanter Skills and other effects that require it; it is treated as being low volume if you target only one creature, and medium volume if you target two or more creatures.
